name: en_fr_translation
description: Translate a common English noun into French (first token of the French word). Control: same template, but repeat the English word.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
pairs = {"dog":"chien","cat":"chat","house":"maison","water":"eau","book":"livre","tree":"arbre","car":"voiture","sun":"soleil","moon":"lune","bread":"pain","cheese":"fromage","apple":"pomme","door":"porte","window":"fenêtre","friend":"ami","city":"ville","school":"école","flower":"fleur","bird":"oiseau","fish":"poisson","horse":"cheval","milk":"lait","table":"table","chair":"chaise","sea":"mer","mountain":"montagne","river":"rivière","night":"nuit","day":"jour","heart":"cœur","hand":"main","head":"tête","king":"roi","queen":"reine","child":"enfant","woman":"femme","man":"homme","boy":"garçon","girl":"fille","world":"monde","love":"amour","time":"temps","money":"argent","wine":"vin","garden":"jardin","street":"rue","country":"pays","sky":"ciel","fire":"feu","earth":"terre","snow":"neige","rain":"pluie","wind":"vent","key":"clé","pen":"stylo","shoe":"chaussure","hat":"chapeau","egg":"œuf","meat":"viande","sugar":"sucre","salt":"sel","butter":"beurre","forest":"forêt","island":"île","bridge":"pont","church":"église","village":"village","star":"étoile","song":"chanson","dream":"rêve","word":"mot","week":"semaine","year":"année"}
words = list(pairs)
random.shuffle(words)
shots = [("dog","chien"),("water","eau"),("book","livre")]
def pre(tgt_lang_fn):
    return "".join(f"English: {e}\n{tgt_lang_fn(e, f)}\n" for e, f in shots)
items = []; control = []
for w in words:
    if w in ("dog","water","book"): continue
    p = "".join(f"English: {e}\nFrench: {f}\n" for e, f in shots) + f"English: {w}\nFrench:"
    items.append({"prompt": p, "answer": " " + pairs[w]})
    c = "".join(f"English: {e}\nRepeat: {e}\n" for e, f in shots) + f"English: {w}\nRepeat:"
    control.append({"prompt": c, "answer": " " + w})
json.dump({"items": items, "control": control}, open("/work/skill.json", "w"))
